items.quote: Jacob did a wonderful job on my lawn which was a TOTAL disaster! He turned it into an awesome, beautiful place. Thank you so much, Jacob!
items.author: Brenda, Davidson, NC

items.quote: Jay was very professional and informative! His prompt arrival was much appreciated! His knowledge creates reassurance that our grass will be cut and taken care of! He even asked was his work ok and provided suggestions before departing! Thank you so much Jay, see you in two weeks.
items.author: Chanyce, Charlotte, NC

items.quote: I am exceedingly pleased with the job that Jacob completed. They put in the most effort to trim around my trees and driveway in a tidy and clean fashion, leaving a yard that looks absolutely amazing. My lawn hasn't looked this fantastic in almost a year.
items.author: Lily, Charlotte, NC

items.quote: Jacob did a great job with my lawn and bushes. I tipped him yesterday.
items.author: Raheya, Mooresville, NC

items.quote: I was glad that Jacob was able to mow the lawn today. Also he did some weeding as well. This has been a huge help for me and my wife. Thank you for this service being provided.
items.author: Ben, Kannapolis, NC

items.quote: Jay was very nice, did a fantastic job and did it in a timely manner. 10/10 would recommend.
items.author: Krysta, Mount Pleasant, NC

items.quote: I just wanted to say thank you for cutting my grass today. You did an excellent job, and I really like how everything looks. I truly appreciate your hard work and attention to detail.
items.author: Wanda, Salisbury, NC
